text: Visitors have noted ongoing issues with crowding, which affects their ability to fully experience the exhibits despite timed entry. Several reviews mention confusion or frustration with the ticketing process, particularly the requirement to purchase tickets online in advance and the lack of cash payment options. Parking has also been a frequent concern, especially due to large vehicles occupying multiple spaces. While many appreciate the interactive exhibits and architecture, some express dissatisfaction with the heavy reliance on AI in the displays and the limited gift shop offerings. Overall, the average rating remains positive, but these operational challenges are recurring themes in critical feedback.
